title: Technician Bench Note — Wiring-Harness Diagnosis on Repeat-Fault Mobility Equipment Chairs
content:
# Repeat-Fault Chairs and the Controller Allowance — Mobility Equipment

**Bench rule.** On a warranty joystick or controller replacement of a Mobility Equipment chair, the controller allowance claimed from the manufacturer is set by the number of repair estimate requests on the chair: with 3 or more requests the controller allowance is the standard controller allowance doubled, to pay for a full wiring-harness and charger diagnosis of a repeat-fault chair; with exactly 2 requests it is the standard controller allowance plus one unit; with fewer the standard controller allowance applies unchanged.

## Requests counted

Every repair estimate request recorded on the chair's wheelchair record, whatever its status.

## Tiers

| Repair estimate requests on the chair | Controller allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | the standard controller allowance, unchanged |
| exactly 2 | the standard controller allowance plus one unit |
| 3 or more | the standard controller allowance doubled |

## Hypothetical cases

- A chair with a single repair estimate request on file: the standard controller allowance, unchanged.
- A chair whose record holds 2 repair estimate requests: plus one unit.
- A chair with 3 requests, the third being the present controller fault: doubled.
